rules.title: Not treated as a payment page
rules.fix: Add <!-- pci:payment-page --> to force the check, or leave it: 6.4.3 and 11.6.1 only bite on pages that take cardholder data.

rules.title: Assessment exposure
rules.fix: Clear the findings above before the next assessment date.

rules.title: No Content-Security-Policy on the payment page
rules.fix: Serve a Content-Security-Policy with an explicit script-src allowlist. That allowlist is the 'method to confirm each script is authorized'.

rules.title: script-src allows 'unsafe-inline' or 'unsafe-eval'
rules.fix: Drop 'unsafe-inline' and 'unsafe-eval'; authorize inline blocks with a per-response nonce instead.

rules.title: script-src authorizes a wildcard host
rules.fix: Replace * / https: / data: with the exact hosts you ship. A wildcard authorizes every script, which is the same as authorizing none.

rules.title: Third-party script loaded with no integrity attribute
rules.fix: Pin the version in the URL and add integrity="sha384-..." crossorigin="anonymous".

rules.title: integrity= present but crossorigin= missing
rules.fix: Add crossorigin="anonymous". Without it the browser sends an opaque request and skips the integrity check entirely.

rules.title: Payment SDK ships unversioned, so SRI cannot cover it
rules.fix: SRI is not available here. Record the authorization and integrity method you do use (vendor attestation, CSP pin, monitoring) next to the tag.

rules.title: Script carries no written business or technical justification
rules.fix: Put <!-- pci:justification why this script is necessary --> immediately above the tag, or a data-pci-justification="..." attribute on it.

rules.title: Script loaded over plain http://
rules.fix: Load it over https://. Over http:// the response can be rewritten in transit and no integrity claim survives.

rules.title: Inline <script> block with no nonce
rules.fix: Add nonce="{generated per response}" and list that nonce in script-src, or move the code into a pinned external file.

rules.title: Tag manager on the payment page
rules.fix: Remove it from the payment page. A container injects scripts at runtime, so nothing loaded on this page can be authorized in advance.

rules.title: No change- and tamper-detection mechanism declared
rules.fix: Deploy a mechanism that alerts on changes to the payment page and its HTTP headers as the browser receives them, then mark it with <!-- pci:tamper-detect vendor/mechanism -->.

rules.title: Card-number field served from your own page
rules.fix: Move the PAN field into the payment provider's hosted iframe. Typed into your own DOM, the page leaves SAQ A for SAQ A-EP or D.
